scope_setup.first_clock_ground: clip lead; alternate ground style not separately recorded

evidence_scope: Diagnostic reports only. Full native analog samples, digital timelines, instrument sessions and wire logs are archived separately by SHA-256; this report does not provide standalone raw-waveform replay.
limitations: Only six full receiver comparisons cover external timing for the whole ten-second run. The ten analog observations each cover fifty milliseconds within a complete firmware workload.
The original streamed five-volt-span clock analog clipped; retain it but do not use it for waveform shape. Triggered voltage observations use a ten-volt clock span.
Raw one-volt clock receivers fail independently of the valid hysteretic clock; the high-range one-volt raw audio marker also fails its measurement count. No raw failures are converted to passes.
The probe swap changes the probe and analog input together. Both retain the placement contrast, but this does not isolate the physical cause from the output, power, board or shared instrument paths.
Measured voltage extrema and transition shapes include probe and ground-lead response; no pin overshoot or sub-bandwidth rise-time claim.
No absolute time calibration, oscillator root cause, audible codec qualification or portable detector-policy change.
